_comment: marus25.cortex-debug is the one extension that is genuinely required for the
hardware debug configurations in launch.json. The STM32Cube extension is
deliberately NOT recommended: it contributes no settings of its own, so its
project auto-discovery cannot be configured off, and it treats every
CMakeLists.txt in the tree -- including the add_subdirectory fragments in
shared/, drivers/, tests/ and each nodes/*/ -- as a standalone project. Those
fragments have no project() call, so configuring them fails with
'No project() command is present'. Use the task palette and CMakePresets
instead; that is what the tasks in tasks.json drive.
If you install the STM32Cube extension anyway, do not use its build view.
It will try to configure the fragments.
